messages:
matt (partnerships): Hey team — StratusGrid sent the joint assets for the Cloud Marketplace listing and the solution brief. Need a quick QA before we approve for the marketplace tile and the case study draft. Files: SG-Redwood-Logos.zip, SG_Redwood_SolutionBrief_v1.pdf, ACME_case_draft.docx

alex (design): Downloading now. Quick ask: do they want the stacked lockup or horizontal lockup on the marketplace? Cloud marketplace tiles prefer horizontal 1:1 spacing so it doesn't crop.

sam (marketing): Also need a single-sentence partner blurb for the tile (max 120 chars) and a 30-word summary for the marketplace metadata. I can draft but want to confirm trademark phrasing.

jordan (legal): FYI — trademark usage: use "StratusGrid" and "Redwood Inference" as proper nouns. Need the partner-signed logo rights form before we publish. Also check customer quote permissions in the case draft (Acme Health).

nina (solutions): On the case study: Acme Health used our Private deployment in a Gx-reg environment. We need an explicit opt-in from them for the patient quote. If they decline, we can still publish an anonymized results paragraph.

alex (design): Quick notes after a pass: their primary logo SVG is good but the white-outline variant is low-res. Request: SVG + EPS + 2x PNG for both dark and light backgrounds. Also ask for the following assets in the portal:
```
assets/
  logos/
    stratusgrid_horizontal.svg
    stratusgrid_stacked.svg
    stratusgrid_reverse.png
  brand/
    SG_brand_guidelines.pdf
    SG_color_values.txt
```

Please confirm hex codes for the gradient (they provided #0A74FF -> #2AC6FF but the PDF shows #0A76FE).

matt (partnerships): Good catch. Sam — can you draft the blurb using "Redwood Inference + StratusGrid" phrasing? Keep it neutral and non-promotional (marketplace rules).

sam (marketing): Drafted two options:
1) "Redwood Inference partners with StratusGrid to deliver low-latency LLM inference on private GPU infrastructure."
2) "Run high-performance LLM inference with Redwood Inference on StratusGrid's dedicated cloud GPUs."
Which is less promotional? I lean #1.

jordan (legal): #1 is safer. Also add: "Trademark notice: \"StratusGrid\" is a registered mark of StratusGrid, Inc." We'll need a copy of their TM for records.

alex (design): Minor visual QA: their horizontal lockup has 6px too little left clearspace per their guidelines. Ask them to resend with the correct safe area or give us permission to crop for the marketplace tile.

matt (partnerships): Action items: 1) Alex request assets (SVG, EPS, 2x PNG, corrected gradient). 2) Sam finalize blurb (#1) and provide the 30-word metadata. 3) Jordan request logo rights + TM proof and quote permissions. 4) Nina coordinate Acme Health opt-in. I'll ping StratusGrid partner rep.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: partnership-assets-deadline in 48h.

sam (marketing): 30-word metadata draft: "Redwood Inference and StratusGrid deliver a secure, low-latency inference solution on dedicated GPU infrastructure—integrated deployment options for enterprise workloads." Happy to tweak.

jordan (legal): Also confirm no PHI in the case screenshots. If any logs/screenshots might include identifiers, redact or use synthetic data.

alex (design): I'll send the asset request email template in #templates and drop an example of the tile crop sizes: 1:1 square 1200x1200, banner 1600x900.

matt (partnerships): Thanks. I'll cc legal on the assets email. If StratusGrid approves before EOD Thursday we can hit next week's marketplace batch.

nina (solutions): I'll reach out to Acme Health today to confirm quote permission + check for PHI in the draft.

matt (partnerships): Great — will follow up after their reply. :thumbsup:
